entities.name: CoaBC-like query protein
observations: 401-aa query matches reviewed bacterial CoaBC proteins at ~45% identity and ~98% query coverage; functional assignment is homology-supported.
Likely bifunctional enzyme in coenzyme A biosynthesis; references bind FMN and Mg2+.

entities.name: Pantothenoylcysteine synthesis
observations: (R)-4'-phosphopantothenate + L-cysteine + CTP → N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + CMP + diphosphate + H+; Rhea: RHEA:19397; EC 6.3.2.5.

entities.name: Phosphopantetheine decarboxylation
observations: N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + H+ → (R)-4'-phosphopantetheine + CO2; Rhea: RHEA:16793; EC 4.1.1.36.

entities.name: Coenzyme A biosynthesis
observations: CoaBC-like protein likely catalyzes consecutive steps 2 and 3 in CoA biosynthesis from (R)-pantothenate.
